title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Bowl on 1972-06-17

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1972 show with stellar Pigpen organ and standout Truckin’/Other One, captured on a decent audience tape that’s a bit cloudy in the second set.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this being possibly the best ’72 performance – Pigpen’s final appearance shines, China Cat glows, and the linked Truckin’→The Other One jam is described as stunning. The recording is an audience capture; while generally good, listeners note some pops, pitch flaws in the original transfer and a cloudy second‑set sound.

ai_rating.rationale: The show receives overwhelming praise for performance and energy, outweighing modest recording imperfections; weighted rating reflects strong musical quality with decent but not pristine audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Original tape has pops, pitch issues and a slightly cloudy sound in the second set; overall listenable for an audience recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Jams are linked together rather than split, giving the show a seamless flow; despite some audio cloudiness the musical continuity is praised.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's resolute organ riffs are highlighted as beautiful and powerful.
